AI Notes.value: Founded 2012 by Gabriel Finotti (BA architecture + urbanism, MFA publishing) in Sao Paulo; now dual-based between Sao Paulo and Marseille (also a Berlin atelier). Small independent studio supplemented by a freelance network of designers, architects, writers and photographers. Work spans graphic design, art direction, brand identity, editorial and environmental design for cultural institutions, fashion, music and hospitality clients. Notable clients include Adidas Originals, Heineken, Sao Paulo Fashion Week, Marina Abramovic Institute, Thames + Hudson and KW Institute for Contemporary Art. Recognised on It's Nice That and The Brand Identity for generative identity work (Caracol). Studio entity, Autonomy not applicable.
